# Security policy

DotReticulum is an experimental project written predominantly by LLM coding agents under human direction. It is **not** audited and must not be used for production or security-critical purposes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's "Report a vulnerability" feature on the Security tab of this repository. Do not open public issues for undisclosed vulnerabilities, and do not include real private keys, captured private traffic, or credentials in any report.

Expect a best-effort acknowledgement; there is no support SLA.

## Scope

Cryptographic primitives follow the Reticulum reference implementation. Issues in upstream Reticulum itself should be reported to its maintainers.
